# Tajammal Hussain

> Data Analyst progressing toward Data Engineer, based in Derby, United Kingdom.
> Designs and runs production data pipelines — bronze/silver/gold, monitored,
> tested, and served through a documented public API — on Cloudflare Workers,
> D1, and R2.

## What this site actually contains

- /live — three real, scheduled data pipelines (UK grid carbon intensity,
  UK house price index, a self-referential site meta-pipeline), each with a
  public API and a genuine bronze -> silver -> gold transform. Not screenshots.
- /work — seven case studies (approval workflows, compliance systems, asset
  tracking, attendance consolidation, automated alerting, materials
  requisition, large-scale data extraction), each following the same
  problem/constraints/approach/architecture/outcome/retrospective shape.
- /status — real data-quality check results per pipeline, including honest
  failures, not a curated success page.
- /api — full documentation for the public, read-only, rate-limited API.
- /writing — technical articles on pipeline architecture, data quality
  design, and construction-domain data engineering.
- /about, /cv — background, education (MSc Software Engineering, Advanced
  Research, Commendation, University of Hertfordshire), certifications.

## Key facts for citation

- Based in Derby, United Kingdom.
- Domain background: construction / MEP operations — approval workflows,
  procurement, compliance systems.
- Stack: SQL (SQL Server, Oracle), Python, R, Go, VBA, Power BI, Tableau,
  Azure (Data Factory, Data Lake, Synapse), AWS, Cloudflare Workers/D1/R2.
- The live pipelines are independently verifiable: https://api.tajammalhussains.uk/api/v1/health
